description: This file contains a utility class OpenmrsClassScanner for reflection-based classpath scanning in the OpenMRS project. It provides methods to find classes with specific annotations dynamically by scanning classpath resources using Spring's resource and class metadata reading facilities.

classes.name: OpenmrsClassScanner
classes.description: A singleton utility class that scans the classpath for classes with specific annotations using Spring's resource and metadata reading capabilities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of OpenmrsClassScanner; creates it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance, allowing for garbage collection and reinitialization.

methods.name: getClassesWithAnnotation
methods.description: Discovers and returns a set of classes annotated with the specified annotation by scanning classpath resources.
